sampling_method: stratified simple random sampling without replacement, equal allocation; unit = representative SKILL.md (one per file_sha); per stratum: frame ordered by file_sha, key = random.Random(2027).random(), smallest keys selected
random_number_generator: Python 3.14.2 random.Random(2027).random(); one generator per stratum; Python guarantees this sequence for an integer seed across versions

database.identified_as: official GitSkills sample database (sample-based methodological experiment; NOT representative of the full GitSkills population)

unit_of_sampling: representative SKILL.md (artifacts.dedup_primary = 1), one per distinct content hash (file_sha)
inclusion_criteria: representative row (dedup_primary = 1) with non-empty SKILL.md text
assigned to a stratum by the ordered rules in sampling_report.md
no selection by keyword, repository popularity, earlier pilots or security signals

scripts.description: at least one executable script among the supporting files

supporting_no_scripts.description: supporting files, but no executable script and no program source

skill_md_only.description: complete listing with no file besides SKILL.md

weighting_note: Equal allocation: population-level estimates must weight each skill by design_weight = N_h / n_h.
